---
title: Custom format
format:
  bare-typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: [fig]
_quarto:
  tests:
    bare-typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ["typst-extras", "typst-extras-list-of\\("]
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'List of Figures' && pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Figure A.1' && pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Appendix A'
---

# A heading

Some text.

![A blue square.](figure.svg){#fig-square fig-alt="A blue square."}

See @fig-square.

# Extra {.appendix}

![An appendix square.](figure.svg){#fig-extra fig-alt="A blue square."}
